value.rationale: Minimum domination parameters are constant on all finite local nonfields and therefore lose most ring-size information. The exact polynomial restores enough information to recover q, s, residue-characteristic parity, and the complete unit-graph isomorphism type within the local class, while also enumerating all dominating and total dominating sets.
